claims.statement: A fixed-complete-organization experience-off switch is inadmissible within C1/U1 and cannot serve as an internal causal test.
claims.domain: Admitted actual UCT tokens in one complete K
claims.proof_or_source: UCT I v1.2 §§2–4; §2.1 of the R183 note
claims.counterexample_or_limit: This does not validate C1 and does not prohibit organizational lesions.

claims.statement: Individual unavoidable relevance equals membership in every minimal successful support and in every successful support.
claims.proof_or_source: R183-T1; inherited CORE20261008 intersection theorem; 65,535-family check
claims.counterexample_or_limit: No actual realizability follows from arbitrary set-family membership.

claims.statement: Full-set single deletion identifies individual unavoidable relevance only with upward closure.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: Nonmonotone protocol-order or gate interactions invalidate the shortcut.

claims.statement: Disjunctive relevance is a hitting-set obligation over minimal supports and does not require an individually universal route.
claims.domain: Finite support families under one target/protocol
claims.counterexample_or_limit: A hitting set is target-relative, not a subject or consciousness core.

claims.statement: With jointly grounded actual P/I/K/M/pi/T, C1 permits the experiential counterpart of a target-unavoidable relation to be called target-relative constitutively relevant, without adding a second causal force.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: No named feeling, scalar amount, actual human instance or C1 validation.

claims.statement: Intact success does not identify the dependence profile; 167 four-relation monotone families share intact success with different unavoidable cores.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: A richer intervention battery can distinguish families; count is not theoretical importance.

claims.statement: A constitutive experiential-type change need not change the selected capability target.
claims.domain: Same fixed J with noninjective complete-type fibers
claims.proof_or_source: Inherited UCT III noninjectivity plus TE3
claims.counterexample_or_limit: Actual complete-type difference must be grounded, not assumed from an analyst variable.
